---
name: Usage feedback / 使用反馈
about: Share a concrete experience, failure, or suggestion / 分享具体使用体验、问题或建议
---

Use English or Chinese, or your preferred language. All prompts are optional.
可以使用中文、英文或你习惯的语言；不用回答全部问题。

Please share only a minimal anonymized excerpt or a made-up example. This issue is public.
只提供最小脱敏片段或自拟例子。这里的内容会公开，请勿提交凭证、学生信息、工作文件或完整私人对话。

### Tried it, or suggesting an idea? / 实际试用还是尚未试用的建议？

### What idea were you examining? / 想检验什么观点？

### What helped or went wrong? / 哪句话有帮助或哪里出了问题？

### Your judgment and reasons / 你保留、修改或仍不确定什么？理由是什么？

### What would you prefer? / 希望如何改善？

### Version and environment, if known / 如方便，说明版本与环境

Skill version, AI product/model, browsing availability. Unknown is fine.
Skill 版本、AI 产品与模型、是否可联网；不知道也可以。
